signature_moves: Semantic tonal descent: headline set in three measured lightness steps (#040404 -> #3F3F3F -> #808080) so the type literally dims line by line, enacting the app's 'light dims as the lid closes' behaviour inside a static image — content-encoding typography, the whole memorable budget spent in one place

Apple-marketing mimicry: pure-white ground + SF Pro + exact apple.com #1D1D1F pill + oversized restrained display type = deliberate 'looks like Apple shipped it' register, borrowing platform familiarity for a solo utility (Jakob's Law)
Big Sur-era icon: indigo gradient squircle with an apex-lit lavender cone lifted off a soft contact shadow
defects: No true design defect observable — but the only surface supplied is a marketing composite, not the app; the faintest headline line would be a Contrast Dilution defect in body copy yet is a defensible large-display device here
Corpus-input gap (not an app defect): submission ships a web marketing composite where a native app UI screenshot belongs — almost all brand evidence, essentially no product evidence

aesthetic.direction: Swiss / International crossed with Apple-marketing minimalism (neo-grotesque product-marketing): near-white + near-black, one restrained accent, hard left grid, oversized grotesque display, decoration-free; kinetic only via the tonal fade
aesthetic.cluster_hint: apple-homage-marketing (web brand surface, not a macOS-UI cluster)

psychology: Jakob's Law — borrows apple.com's visual signature (white, SF Pro, #1D1D1F pill) so a solo utility inherits platform familiarity and its trust prior
Von Restorff / signal-detection — exactly one saturated element (the black CTA pill) and one colour moment (the indigo icon) on an otherwise achromatic page, so both are pre-attentively unmissable
Peak-End / demonstrate-don't-describe — the tonal-fade headline demonstrates the product's effect typographically rather than describing it, the page's single peak moment
Aesthetic-usability effect — high structural hygiene (one alignment axis, disciplined tonal ramp) buys the perceived-quality halo on first contact
notes: CRITICAL for synthesis: NO native macOS app UI was provided — inputs are a web marketing composite (cover.jpg, 2400x1260) + a 256px app icon only. The app is a menu-bar 'Lid Angle Sync & Keep Awake' utility, plausibly AppKit NSMenuBarExtra, but its UI lineage/era/native-fidelity are UNMEASURED — do not infer native taste from this app. All tokens above are brand/web/icon evidence and must NOT feed macOS UI canon or clusters. The rubric score (11/14) is for the marketing surface, not the product. Era 'unknown' at app level; icon alone reads Big Sur/liquid-glass gradient-squircle family (flat 256px render can't separate the two).
